about_the_game:
Operative Revolve is a cinematic roguelike deckbuilder with a unique gameplay mechanic. Play as Operatives, secret agents who oversee a world governed by machine ideology. Use your Machine cards to physically attack or block damage while battling enemies who oppose your directive and uncover the hidden truths within the machinated world.

Each card can be upgraded by installing unique frame and wheel component. Each component boasts its own distinct design and effects - Utilize them to optimize your cards and experiment with different gameplay strategies.

  • Destructible Cards - Cards destroyed in battle do not restore themselves until the next battle. They have their own unique health system, indicated by both the number on their wheel and the wheel type, which changes how damage is calculated.

  • Assets - Powerful resources which further improve your component-card combos or create new gameplay strategies.

  • Intense Combat - Featuring unique combat mechanics that alters gameplay mechanics.

  • Chain Mechanics - Explore multiple ways to chain your strategies into powerful combos.

  • Evolving Challenge - Enemies come in varied forms and employ dynamic attack strategies. Enemy behaviors can be rolled and remixed each run.

  • Replayability - Each run is different. Select 2 out of 6 Operatives to battle against enemies with evolving behaviors, experiencing a myriad of interactions with the Operatives, world building, and story.

  • Multi-Directional - Card placement is key to your strategy, enemies will attack from different directions.

  • Combination Deck - Each Operative has their own set of unique cards, designed to synergize differently when paired with a different Operative.

  • Optimization - This game is optimized to run smoothly on older devices. We aim to release with Steam Deck verification.

  • Deep Lore - Command your Operatives in battle while unraveling the deep mystery of the omniscient Machine Doctrine.

short_description: A cinematic roguelike deckbuilder where your cards are physically activated "Machines". Enemies can strike, pierce, or bomb them to pieces. Install components to strengthen your cards, or experiment with triggering chain reactions and other thrilling ways to destroy your enemies.
